description: a(1) = 1, a(2) = 2; for n > 2, a(n) is an unused number that is as close as possible to a(n-1), shares a factor with a(n-1), and rad(a(n)*a(n-1)) has not previously occurred as the rad value of the product of adjacent terms, where rad(k) = A007947(k). If two such numbers exist then the smaller is chosen.
